source.evidence: Appendix A.4, Tables 6-7; source inputs are existing 3D hand-object demonstrations, not raw RGB video.

interpretation: The GPU-hour values multiply the reported median by the number of task records and are only an order-of-magnitude estimate. Full per-task times and concurrency were not published. The 42.6% yield describes physics-based retargeting after 3D input is available, not an end-to-end RGB-video acceptance rate.
